revisions.evidence: BLEAK_OUTCOME callbackOnDeath restores source vim using its effect stacks.
DEMON_BLADE callbackOnMeleeAttack projects a radius-one fire ball on each qualifying hit.
FIERY_GRASP applies movement prevention, fire damage, and its optional silence.
BURNING_PLAGUE deals periodic fire damage and its death callback spreads/explodes the flame.
DEMON_SEED_CORRUPT_LIGHT activates inc_damage.all by the displayed percentage.
DEMON_SEED stores the displayed maturation-recovery chance and handles it on death.
CURSED_FLAMES timeout heals its source and grants vim while fire effects remain.
FIERY_TORMENT activates fire resistance reduction and fiery_torment vulnerability; its long description explicitly says the target is highly vulnerable to Fearscape flames.
revisions.required_correction: Translate the heightened Fearscape-flame vulnerability, not merely ordinary burning, and use the established name 恐惧空间.

revisions.evidence: PURIFIED_BY_FIRE removes the displayed percentage of maximum life each turn.
LINK_OF_PAIN callbackOnHit transfers the displayed percentage to eff.victim.
FIRE_SHIELD tracks absorption then damages its displayed radius when it collapses.
ONLY_ASHES_LEFT ends on death or when the source is absent or beyond max distance.
OMINOUS_SHADOW converts all damage and uses auto-highest darkness increase and penetration.
FIRE_HAVEN grants 40 fire affinity and -15 blight resistance.
DEMON_SEED_DOOMED_NATURE adds failure chances for natural and mind talents and projects radius-one fire on failure.
VORACIOUS_BLADE grants critical certainty for the remaining melee-hit count and adds critical power.
REBIRTH_BY_FIRE directly splits its periodic life loss among itself and burning foes in the displayed radius.
